text:
Maya Li: Support case INC-1245 — customers (acme-inc, tinyfinance) getting 502/504s after a staged deploy, started ~07:42 UTC. Escalating to SRE. :rotating_light:

Samir Gupta: seeing gateway error spike in prod-west. error-rate from ~0.4% -> ~5.8% at 07:43. Traces show 'upstream read timeout' and 'no route found' logs.

Priya Patel: customer reported API calls timing out and retries causing billing duplicates. Support ticket link: https://support.redwood/INC-1245

Omar Reyes: which deploy id? I see deploy release-2026-03-16-2b7f rolled to prod-west at 07:40 by CI.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: release-2026-03-16-2b7f -> prod-west @07:40 UTC. rollout=staged(20%).

Samir Gupta: quick grep in gateway logs:
```
ERROR gateway: upstream read timeout host=upstream-legacy-1 id=abc123 route_tag=beta-17
WARN router: no matching backend for route-tag beta-17
```
So looks like a route-tag toggle sent a subset of traffic to a legacy gateway that doesn't have the new prefix mappings.

Alice Chen: I can reproduce locally by sending the header `x-route-tag: beta-17` — curl returns 502 with same upstream timeout.

Priya Patel: customer notes that billing webhook retries are firing because of these 502s, leading to duplicated charges in a couple of accounts. They're asking for timeline and rollback ETA.

Samir Gupta: checking config history — route-tag.beta was enabled via ops-config change at 07:39 as part of the staged rollout. It leaked to prod-west staging slice due to a templating bug that matched 'beta-*' to legacy backends.

Omar Reyes: steps to reproduce for SRE:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'x-route-tag: beta-17' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 502 
 body: "upstream read timeout"

Priya Patel: can we rollback the config flag and notify customers? Support will hold on replies until we have fix.

Samir Gupta: initiating rollback of route-tag flag for prod-west now.
Command:
```
./ops/flag-toggle --env prod-west --flag route-tag.beta --set false --audit "rollback - INC-1245"
```

deploy-bot: flag-toggle executed by samir@infra at 07:55 UTC. New rollout: route-tag.beta=false. Audit: rollback-INC-1245.

Samir Gupta: also added a temporary rate-limit on retries for billing webhooks to avoid duplicate charges (policy id: bill-retry-guard-2026-03-16).

Maya Li: monitoring error-rate and customer impact for next 15m. If stable, we'll confirm resolution with support and CS. :eyes:

Alice Chen: post-rollback curl with x-route-tag header returns 200 for same requests. Verified across two pods.

Priya Patel: support notified customers, opened a billing reconciliation ticket with finance (FIN-342). Customer happy to wait for postmortem. :thumbsup:

Omar Reyes: assigning postmortem: Samir (owner), Alice (infra), Priya (customer impact). Runbook link: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/deploy-config-verification

Maya Li: next actions: short-term - confirm full rollback and rate-limit persist; medium - add stricter templating validation in ops-config pipeline; long-term - add synthetic monitor to hit route-tag paths during staged rollouts.

Samir Gupta: will submit a PR for validation and schedule a postmortem meeting. Thanks all.

support-bot: INC-1245 updated: status=investigating -> mitigated. Customer notified. Timestamp=07:59 UTC

Maya Li: closing loop once error-rate stable < baseline for 30m. Good catch everyone.
